column1: # bpf_func_proto slice — REAL kernel contracts, extracted from the bpf-next tree
# in .lab/bpf-next (source 3 of the ground truth). Auto-extraction from the tree is
# still TODO; this curated slice feeds the diff helper-arg check today.
# INCLUSION RULE: an entry is listed ONLY when its arg_type maps to exactly ONE
# verifier reg-type family. Args typed ARG_ANYTHING (any reg is valid) or
# ARG_PTR_TO_MEM/_OR_NULL (legitimately fp OR map_value OR pkt ...) are
# deliberately LEFT OUT — asserting a single family there would manufacture false
# positives. Omitted == "cannot corroborate", which the diff stage treats as
#   arg1 ARG_PTR_TO_MEM|MEM_RDONLY and arg3 ARG_ANYTHING: omitted (many valid types)
#   arg0/arg3 ARG_PTR_TO_MEM variants: omitted (many valid types)
